title: Promise reduction to three-CNF satisfiability
statement: Let binary encodings be given for Boolean circuits and three-CNF formulas, and suppose there is a certified polynomial-time map on binary strings that sends every canonical circuit encoding to the canonical encoding of its associated three-CNF formula and sends every malformed circuit encoding to a malformed formula encoding. Then the promise problem whose yes instances are encodings of satisfiable circuits and whose no instances are encodings of unsatisfiable circuits is polynomial-time Karp reducible to the corresponding promise problem for three-CNF satisfiability.
